title: HJC HJ-31 Dark Smoke Face Shield
features: OEM optical polycarbonate shield with 99% UV-A and UV-B radiation rejection
Pinlock-ready mounting pins engineered for Pinlock 70 MaxVision insert
Anti-scratch hard-coat surface engineered for durability in high-debris slipstreams
Precision ratchet pivot mechanism enables seamless toolless shield swap
description:
Engineered to withstand harsh ultraviolet radiation and dense condensation, the HJC HJ-31 Dark Smoke Face Shield from HJC elevates visual clarity across demanding weather conditions. Built with Hydrophobic Rain-Shedding Exterior Coating with Perimeter Airtight Seal, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Toolless quick-release pivot lever swap in 10 seconds).

The HJC HJ-31 Dark Smoke Face Shield is an essential visual clarity upgrade from HJC. By delivering edge-to-edge optical fidelity and bulletproof fog prevention, it dramatically improves situational awareness across unpredictable climates.
